name_input: M/S SUPERSMELTERS LIMITED; SUPER SMELTERS LIMITED; Super Smelters Ltd; SUPER SMELTERS LTD.; SUPER SMELTERS LIMITED
export_evidence: ImportKey, page 'SUPER SMELTERS LTD' (39, Shakespeare Sarani, Kolkata): "2026-02-09 SUPER SMELTERS LTD TO THE ORDER FERRO SILICO MANGANNESE (DTLS AS PER INVOICE)- DURGAPUR ICD INDUR6, India Venezia, ITALY 72023000 9497412"; same page: "2026-02-25 ... HIGH CARBON FERRO MANGANESE 72% ... Gdansk, POLAND 72021100 1004878" and "2026-02-20 SUPER SMELTERS LTD G.T TRADING PVT. LTD. MS PIPE-JW SIZE: 25X25X2MM ... Phuntsholing, BHUTAN 73063090 9843140". Page counter: "Total Shipments 798 Records detected", "Trading Partners 18", "Latest Cargo 2026-02-25"; rows actually visible in the free view: 5 shipment rows (dates 2026-02-25, 2026-02-20, 2026-02-13, 2026-02-10, 2026-02-09). Second page 'SUPER SMELTERS LIMITED' (Jamuria Industrial Estate, Rajaramdanga, PO Ikra, Jamuria, Burdwan): counter "Total Shipments 153 Records detected", "Latest Cargo 2025-11-29", 5 rows visible, all inbound imports (manganese ore Gabon HS 26020010, South African steam coal HS 27011920, bearings, clutch brake, grinding wheel) — i.e. raw-material imports, not exports.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report domestic/export split could be retrieved: web_search returned no results (searx connection refused) and volza/eximpedia returned HTTP 403. Only indirect indication of domestic-side activity is the plant address in the customs record ("FACTORY-JAMURIA INDUSTRIAL ESTATE RAJARAM DANGA, PO. IKRA, JAMURIA BURDWAN") and inbound raw-material imports (manganese ore, steam coal) consistent with in-house ferro-alloy production; no domestic sale record with buyer, value or date was seen.
note: Export side is factually confirmed: dated customs/B-L records with HS codes and B-L numbers show outbound ferro silico manganese (HS 72023000) to Italy on 2026-02-09 and high-carbon ferro manganese (HS 72021100) to Poland/Turkey in Feb 2026, plus MS pipes to Bhutan. Declared HS 720230 matches the observed ferro-silico-manganese line, so no HS correction is needed; note the company also ships 72021100 (HC ferro manganese) and 73063090 (MS pipes). Two ImportKey entity pages exist for the same group (Kolkata office 798 records; Jamuria works 153 records) — the Jamuria page rows are imports only. Domestic supply: no public GST turnover, tender or contract evidence found, so status is declared_only, not confirmed. Revenue and export volume figures are not public in the free views — null, not estimated.
